senses.gloss: cintaka, m. inspector, overseer: rājño Mūrdhātasyāmātyāś cintakās tulakā upaparīkṣakāś cintayitvā tulayitvā … Divy 〔212.9〕; karvaṭakaḥ saṃnāmito nipakā gṛhītāś cintakaḥ (an overseer, manager) sthāpitaḥ. Divy 〔451.20〕; for this last, MSV 〔i.147.2〕 reads citrakaḥ, doubtless by corruption; Tib. sna bo, leader, commander.

cinnaka, m. (presumably = Skt. cīna, cīnaka, and Lex. cinna, Panicum miliaceum; cf. also AMg. ciṇṇa, Chinese), a kind of grain or legume: kodravo vā śyāmako vā cinnako vā priyaṃgur vā … Mv 〔ii.211.14〕.
